text:
Elena: FYI procurement loop — SignalBridge sent pricing. Need help picking between per-seat, committed-usage (monthly API calls/tokens), or hybrid. Key constraints: Dedicated customers (~5-10k API calls/day), SSO/SCIM + SOC2, and possible 12mo or 24mo commit. Can someone sanity-check costs and caveats?

Diego: Can you paste their numbers? also we need a normalized $/1k calls (and token) to compare across options.

Elena: Pasting vendor table below: 
```
Option A - Per-seat: $120/user/mo, min 10 seats
Option B - Committed usage: $0.025 / 1k API calls, 10% discount on annual prepay (12mo)
Option C - Hybrid: $80/user/mo + $0.0125 / 1k calls for overage
Enterprise Add-on: 99.9% SLA + 24/7 support = $12,000/yr
Embedding compute: billed separately per 1M tokens @ $50/1M (unless included in committed token tiers)
```

Priya: For context, our estimate = ~7k calls/day (~210k/mo). Seats needed ~8 (platform + SRE). Embedding batch jobs could add ~2M tokens/mo. That token number matters a lot.

Diego: Quick back-of-envelope:
- Option A: 8 * $120 * 12 = $11,520/yr (seats only; embedding billed extra)
- Option B: 210k/1k * $0.025 * 12 = $63,000/yr (no embed discount)
- Option C: seats 8*$80*12 = $7,680 + calls 210k/1k*$0.0125*12 = $31,500 => ~$39,180/yr
So Option A is cheapest if seats cover usage and embeddings are small, Option C looks middle if usage moderate, Option B only wins at very high scale or heavy token discounts.

Elena: Good — two vendor clarifications to get: 1) Does their 'API call' metric include embedding requests or are tokens billed separately? 2) Do they support AWS KMS + customer-managed keys for Private? 3) Discount schedule for 12mo vs 24mo commits? 4) Early termination and refund language?

Mark (SignalBridge): Quick clarifications from our side — API call count treats embeddings as 1 call per request; embedding compute is billed separately by tokens unless you buy a committed token tier. We do support AWS KMS for Private deployments. Discount: 12mo = 15% off list, 24mo = 25% off. Early termination: pro-rated refund for unused months minus a 3-month minimum charge (negotiable for enterprise). SLA add-on is negotiable for enterprise customers.

Sam (Legal): Don't accept an open "pro-rated minus 3 months" clause without a cap. Need DPA & security appendix (SOC2 report + pen test summary). Also request standard limitation of liability and export controls language.

Elena: Can we ask Mark for an itemized quote with committed tiers (50k/mo, 200k/mo, 500k/mo), and a token-level breakout so we can model embeddings separately? Also want SOC2 snapshot + recent pen test report and a sample DPA.

procure-bot: Created ticket VB-3421: signalbridge-quote-request — assigned to @Elena. Link: https://tickets.internal/VB-3421

Diego: @Priya can you confirm whether embeddings token-level billing is a hard blocker? If embeddings are heavy the committed token tier will change the math.

Priya: Yes — embeddings are the blocker. Our batch ingestion is ~2M tokens/mo; if embeddings are charged at $50/1M tokens that adds ~$100/mo, but if it's per-call compute it could be much higher. Also we need an on-prem connector for PII workflows or a clear path for Private deployment.

Mark (SignalBridge): Noted — I'll return a revised quote with 3 committed tiers, token breakout, SOC2 snapshot, and sample DPA/pen-test summary within 48 hours.

Elena: Thanks. If numbers look close, preference is 12mo commit with a conversion clause to move to 24mo rate if usage expands after 6 months. @Sam please flag anything else to require before procurement signs.

Sam (Legal): :thumbsup: will review T&Cs and the VB-3421 attachments when they come in.
